exposure: Standardized multidisciplinary protocol for managing placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders
Management with standardized protocol vs. case-by-case management
standardized multidisciplinary protocol for managing placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders
cohort: 75 patients with PAS (39 historical controls, 36 managed with protocol)
finding: The implementation of a standardized multidisciplinary protocol for managing placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders was associated with reduced composite maternal morbidity and blood loss in women with confirmed PAS.
